name: Mila Jovanović
work_authorization: Serbian citizen. No work permit for the EU or the US.
headline: Junior data analyst with internship experience in e-commerce reporting, SQL and Power BI.

facts.text: BSc in Economics, University of Novi Sad, graduated 2025. Thesis on regional retail price trends using regression analysis.
Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, completed 2025.
Six-month data analyst internship at PazarPlus, an online marketplace in Serbia, February to July 2025.
At PazarPlus, built a weekly sales dashboard in Power BI used by the five-person category team.
At PazarPlus, wrote PostgreSQL queries to clean and join order and returns data, cutting a manual monthly report from about two days to half a day.
Personal project: analysed three years of Novi Sad public transport ridership data with Python (pandas, matplotlib) and published the notebook on GitHub.
Personal project: Tableau Public dashboard of Serbian housing prices by city.
Skills: SQL (PostgreSQL), Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP), Python (pandas, matplotlib), Power BI, basic Tableau.
Coursework in statistics: hypothesis testing, linear regression and A/B test analysis.
Worked remotely for two months of the internship, using Slack and Jira.
Volunteer, 2023 to 2024: maintained the donations spreadsheet and monthly report for a local animal shelter.
